title: Advanced Shape Creation & Boolean Geometry
subtitle: Add, Subtract, Intersect, Xor, Divide, Non-destructive Compound Shapes
description: Unlock procedural vector construction: parametric primitive handles, interactive corner types via the Corner Tool (C), the 5 core Boolean operations, and non-destructive Compound Shapes via Alt/Option modifiers.
prerequisites: D02: Vector Nodes, Paths & Pen Tool Geometry
learningOutcomes: Manipulate orange parametric handles on specialized primitives (Cog, Star, Donut, Crescent).
Apply and bake corner radiuses with the Corner Tool (C) using Rounded, Concave, Straight, and Cutout types.
Execute destructive Boolean operations: Add, Subtract, Intersect, Xor, and Divide.
Construct fully non-destructive Compound Shapes using Alt (Win) / Option (Mac) modifiers.
Convert procedural parametric primitives into standard editable vector Bezier curves (Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter).

capstoneProject.title: Camera Aperture & Mechanical Lens Emblem
capstoneProject.description: Construct an intricate camera lens emblem using a procedural Cog or Donut base, non-destructive Compound subtractions, and stylized Corner Tool chamfers.
evaluationCriteria: Base emblem built using parametric primitives.
Compound Shape layer used non-destructively with editable child primitives.
Corner Tool chamfers or radiuses applied to corner vertices.
